$comment: §4.2: an already-expired University Term Dates Letter is not accepted. Shared by packages/domain/src/__tests__/documents.test.ts (termLetterDatesVerdict) and supabase/tests/598_term_letter_dates_in_the_future.sql (term_letter_expired). Ranges are inclusive ISO dates as the letter prints them; the SQL side receives the half-open daterange [from, to + 1 day).

cases.name: §4.2 last day is today → still current (a range ending today has a day left)
§4.2 one past range and one to come → current, the rule is about all of them
§4.2 next year's letter, every range ahead → current
§4.2 a range that starts before today and ends after it → current
§4.2 no ranges found → no_dates, not expired (ADR-0014: the human still reviews)
§4.2 a range typed backwards is judged on its later end
